**Dispatch mechanism assumption 1 is falsified, on the record.** The ratchet's `MAX_LINE_BYTES` (120) binds, the old lines were already 118/119 B, and the ruled text needs four lines. The seat's net-0 reading was wrong.

Not executed by the seat: the dev's Edit for that deletion was refused by this session's permission classifier (`Modify Shared Resources`) and was not retried by any route — a refused permission is surfaced, never routed around. B (a ruled raise 101 → 102 under the ratchet's maintainer exit, quoting item 4 in the PR body) stays open as the maintainer's alternative; C (a lossy three-line form) is refused by the seat.

Maintainer-action: say A (the dev retries the one-line deletion of landing-operations.md's main-red ③ line with your word quoted; if the classifier refuses again, the deletion is your hand on branch `claude/issue-23201-deliberate-correction-text-only`) or B (rule the 101 → 102 raise, quoted in the PR body) — done when `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` is green on PR #23257's head.

The carried `rest-channel.md` line (ruling item 5's relay entry) is held by #23193's own card (its last bullet) and by this seat's post (#7623, hot-file queue), not by this card; `WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_ALLOWLIST` on `origin/main` still names `shard-timings-refresh.yml` only, and PR #23209 is open.
